variables.decision: Whether to fund a $40k technician retraining program in Q1
variables.population: Residential service calls, all three branches
data_inventory: service_calls_2025_2026.csv — one row per service visit; date, branch, technician_id, job_type, parts_on_truck, fixed_first_visit
variables.business_context: Regional HVAC service company with three branches. First-visit fix rate drives labor cost and customer reviews. Leadership believes newer technicians are the problem and is weighing a retraining program.
variables.output_style: Short bullets, then a table, plain tone
variables.framed_question: How did first-visit fix rate change in Q3 2026 vs Q3 2025, and which segments account for the change?
variables.evidence_bar: Probable is enough for a pilot; Confirmed needed for the full $40k program
